3. Murc d? tu chu va trach nhiem (R)
R1. Lam viec nhom, lam viec doc lap va day manh tinh chuyen nghiep dao
durc va trach nhiem xa hoi trong hoat dong truyen thong so
R2. Chu dong cap nhat xu huong, thich urng linh hoat voi sy thay doi cua
nganh.
R3. Chiu trach nhiém voi cong viéc ca nhan, nhom va dy an tham gia.
R4. Huong dan, giam sat va ho tro dong nghiep trong moi truong lam viéc
chuyen nghiep.
R5. Lap ké hoach, giao tiep hieu qua, dieu phoi nhom va danh gia, cai tién
hoat dong chuyen mon hieu qua.

Nha Thiét ke Do hoa Chuyen dong (Animator/Motion Graphics
Designer): Thiet ke cac san pham truyen thong dong cho quang cao, giai tri, giao
duc, tao hieu ung va hinh anh chuyen dong sir dung trong video, quang cao, truyen
hinh, va cac nen tang so.
Chuyen vien Sang tao noi dung (Content Creator): Thuc hien cac nhiem
vu xay dung va thiét ke noi dung, phat trien y tuong cho chien dich truyen thong, su
kien tryrc tuyén, cac bai dang tren mang xa hoi va san xuat video ngan.
Chuyen vien thiet ke trc quan ( Visual designer): Tao cac yéu to hinh anh
thu hut, nhat quan cho thuong hieu va san pham, dam bao tinh tham my va hap dan.
Phoi hop chat che voi chuyen gia UI/UX de truyen dat thong diep ro rang va tao trai
nghiem nguoi dung lien mach, theo xu huong hien dai.
Chuyen vien thiét ke giao dien nguoi dung (UI designer): Tap trung vao
viec xay dung va thiet ke cac yeu to giao dien ma nguoi dung tryc tiép tuong tac,
dam bao giao dien dep mat, de sur dung va dap ung tieu chuan tham my cao, hop tac
voi cac nhom lien quan de dam bao rang san pham mang lai trai nghiem lien mach,
tryc quan va than thien voi nguoi dung.
Chuyen vien thiet ke trai nghiem nguoi dung ( UX designer): Chiu trach
nhiem nghien curu va thiét ke trai nghiem tong the cua nguoi dung khi ho turong tac
voi san pham. Cong viec bat dau tir viec tim hieu hanh vi va nhu cau cua nguoi dung
thong qua cac nghien curu, khao sat, va thu nghiem nguoi dung, hop tac voi cac
nhom lien quan dé dam bao rang san pham mang lai trai nghiem lien mach, tryrc
quan va than thien voi nguoi dung.
Chuyen vien thiét ke game (Game designer): Nha thiet ke tro choi; Nha
thiét ké kich ban game; Thiet ke trai nghiem tro choi; kiem th'r chat lurong tro choi;
van hanh game
Chuyen vien thiet ke do hoa game: Thiet ke moi truong va vat pham; Thiet
ke nhan vat; Hoa si dien hoat chuyen dong; Nha thiet ke tro choi; Thiet ke giao dien
tro choi; thiét ke hieu ung (VFX); kiem thur chat luong tro choi.
Chuyen vien San xuat Game (Game Producer): Quan ly dy an phat trien
game, bao gom lap ke hoach, phan bo nguon lurc, giam sat tién do va phoi hop giura
cac bo phan de hoan thanh dur an.
Quan ly Truyen thong hinh anh: Dam bao tinh dong nhat va surc hap dan cua
thuong hieu qua hinh anh, quan ly va giam sat quy trinh san xuat hinh anh thuong hieu.
Chuyen vien truyen thong, thiet ke noi dung so, quan ly va phat trien nen
tang truyen thong so trong khu vuc hanh chinh cong nha nuoc va dia phuong.
Giang day va Nghien curu: Tham gia giang day ve linh vyrc Truyen thong va
Thiét ke tai cac truong Dai hoc, Cao dang hoac cac vien nghien curu trong va ngoai
nuoc.
Quan ly Thiet ke: Lanh dao doi ngu thiét ke, phat trien hinh anh thuong hieu,
dinh huong hinh anh cho cac dy an truyen thong cua cong ty.
Quan ly Sang tao: Chiu trach nhiem phat trién cac chien dich truyen thong
sang tao, dinh hinh va quan ly hinh anh thuong hieu tren cac nen tang truyen thong
va trong cac san pham game.
Quan ly Truyen thong Ky thuat so (Digital Media Manager): Len ké
hoach va quan ly chién luroc truyen thong so, toi uu hoa quang cao va tiép thi tren
cac kenh tryrc tuyen, theo doi ket qua truyen thong.
Nha Quan ly San pham (Product Manager): Phat trien va quan ly cac san
pham truyen thong, bao gom nghien curu thi truong, len chién luoc phat trien va dua
ra lo trinh san pham.
